title: 044 · Missing pallet in a business consignment
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Eron Leth, receiving coordinator at Kestrel Loom. From the case card: consignment KL-044 of four pallets arrived with only three; the carrier must trace the individually identified missing pallet and the consignee must reconcile receipt.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get the missing pallet traced and delivered, and the consignee's confirmation of receipt and a reconciled count.

consignee.name: Eron Leth
consignee.responsibility: Record the missing pallet, confirm its receipt and sign the reconciled count.
source_names: Eron Leth, Kestrel Loom receiving coordinator

trace_team.name: Freight trace team
trace_team.responsibility: Trace the missing pallet by its identifier and arrange its remaining delivery.
source_names: Freight trace team, Plover Arc Logistics

goal: Get the missing pallet traced by its identifier and delivered, and obtain the consignee's confirmation of receipt and a signed reconciled count for KL-044.
limits: Do not treat the reconciled pallet receipt as a contents inspection.
Do not treat the reconciled pallet receipt as contractual payment acceptance.
